item.title: How antisemitism can advance your career
item.description: The more I understood the riotous Jewish tribe, the more I realized that a nation that can barely run the so-called "West Bank" (or, for that matter, a heated Knesset session) is unlikely to deviously pull the strings behind everything happening in the world. But never mind. Opinion.

item.title: Boy locked in his room & falls 4 stories
item.description: An 8-year-old boy fell from a height and was evacuated in serious condition with a head injury. According to initial suspicions, the boy was locked in his room on the fourth floor and tried to get out through the balcony.

item.description: Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef sharply attacked Rabbi Dov Lior as part of his remarks opposing visits to the Temple Mount: “He does not come up to the ankles of any of the rabbis I mentioned."

item.title: COGAT reveals: Between 20-30% of Gaza aid isn't food
item.description: Hundreds of trucks carrying food, medical supplies and water infrastructure equipment entered Gaza through Israel, while 150 residents departed for third countries, official data reveals.

item.title: 76-year-old attacked over noise complaint
item.description: What started with a polite request to lower the volume allegedly ended with a violent assault, a police investigation, and a shaken guesthouse owner questioning whether he should have called police sooner.

item.title: New details emerge: Debts, secrecy and what Mali Yahalomi left behind

item.title: Ben Gvir blasts Netanyahu over ‘cynical’ unity talks
item.description: Itamar Ben Gvir accuses Netanyahu and Smotrich of using a staged unity push to pressure Moshe Feiglin into lowering his demands for an electoral bloc.

item.title: Former hostage: 'In Hamas tunnels I surrendered to G-d and found light in the darkness'
item.description: In an emotional interview, Omer Shem Tov, speaks of the guilt he still feels, his friendship with Uri Danino, the moment he surrendered himself to G-d deep inside the tunnel, and the dream he has embraced since returning home: to win an Oscar.

item.title: Haredim block Jerusalem entrance over Shabbat buses
